reason: The base preregistration fixed the cluster-bootstrap method, replicate count, seed, and interpretation but did not operationally freeze the exact resampling unit, cross-model pairing, high-K clustering rule, reported statistic, or interval construction. This addendum fixes those details before materialization, training, evaluation, or result access without changing any base field.

physical_cell_definition.highK_and_full10k_K_rule: use min(K_abs,0.8) for cluster assignment only
physical_cell_definition.metric_K_rule: always retain and evaluate the original unclipped K_abs
physical_cell_definition.highK_interpretation: Clipping is only a deterministic clustering extension of the frozen in-support cell partition; it is not model input clipping and does not convert high-K rows into in-support evidence.

resampling.observed_cells_drawn_per_replicate: C draws with replacement from the C distinct cells observed within the reported frame or panel
resampling.row_policy: include every member row of each drawn cell with the draw multiplicity
resampling.cross_model_pairing: use the identical resampled row multiset for both arms and all three paired seeds
resampling.panel_policy: cluster membership and resampling are computed separately within each reported frame or panel
resampling.empty_frame_or_missing_arm_policy: fail closed and retain the failed denominator

reported_statistic.per_replicate: for every preregistered scalar metric, recompute each seed-level large-minus-small delta on the resampled row multiset and take the arithmetic mean across the three paired seeds
reported_statistic.point_estimate: unbootstrapped arithmetic mean of the three paired seed deltas
reported_statistic.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the 2000 replicate statistics

scope.meaning: finite-frame spatial-composition sensitivity conditional on the six frozen trained models
